title: Information processing method, apparatus, electronic device, and computer-readable storage medium
abstract: The embodiment of the invention discloses an information processing method, an information processing device, electronic equipment and a computer readable storage medium; the related embodiments can be applied to various scenes such as cloud technology, artificial intelligence, intelligent transportation, auxiliary driving and the like. According to the method, after interaction information to be processed is obtained, interaction objects participating in interaction are extracted from the interaction information to be processed, after an interaction object set is obtained, target interaction information of each interaction object in the interaction object set is respectively screened out from a preset interaction information set, interaction characteristics of the interaction objects are extracted from the target interaction information, then the interaction characteristics are converted into time sequence characteristics, then the time sequence characteristics are fused to obtain target time sequence characteristics corresponding to the interaction information to be processed, and then target information of the interaction information to be processed is determined according to the target time sequence characteristics; the scheme can improve the accuracy of information processing.

title: Service processing method and device
abstract: The embodiment of the specification provides a service processing method and a device, wherein the service processing method comprises the steps of being applied to terminal equipment, wherein the terminal equipment is provided with equipment application, a service container and a receiving and sending client side, the service container is used for carrying out equipment login processing and service scene subscription processing of the terminal equipment, the method comprises the steps that the receiving and sending client side receives service information of subscribing a service scene sent by the service side through a data link, the receiving and sending client side responds to initialization calling of the equipment application to establish the data link, the service information is transmitted into the equipment application to display the service information through the equipment application, and if the service information is triggered, the service container is called to obtain service detail data corresponding to the service information.

title: Multimedia information interaction method and system
abstract: The invention provides a method and a system for multimedia information interaction, wherein the method comprises the following steps: registering a network terminal; the network terminal acquires information, push information and a user-defined grouping rule; the network terminals carry out grouping; the network terminal receives information sharing and information interaction; and the network terminal displays the information and dynamically updates the information. The system comprises a server group and an information alliance management platform, wherein the server group comprises: the system comprises a data server, a strategy server, an application server and an information management server. The information sharing and information interaction between the network terminals and among the network terminals are realized, all information is updated in real time according to the user characteristics, and the information utilization rate is improved.

title: Information processing apparatus, storage medium, and information processing method
abstract: The invention provides an information processing apparatus, a storage medium, and an information processing method, which can execute a processing request after determining a relevant user related to the processing request when the processing request is received from a processing request transmitting apparatus. An information processing apparatus is provided with a processor that receives a device ID and a processing request that identify the processing request transmitting device from the processing request transmitting device, and executes processing related to the processing request after determining a relevant user related to the processing request based on the device ID.

title: Information processing method, device, terminal and storage medium
abstract: The present disclosure provides an information processing method and apparatus, a terminal, and a storage medium. The information processing method comprises the following steps: displaying the first evaluation information and the second evaluation information in a first page; the first page comprises a first display area and a second display area, the first display area displays first evaluation information aiming at a preset user, and the second display area displays second evaluation information aiming at the preset user; and in response to the triggering operation of the first display area in the first page, displaying the first task information in the display area of the first evaluation information. By displaying the first task information in the display area of the first evaluation information and having the association relationship with the second evaluation information in time, the corresponding reference information can be provided in the page of the evaluation system, eliminating the need to manually input the first task information and improving the convenience of the user and the efficiency of information processing.

title: Generator detection method, electronic device and storage medium
abstract: The application provides a detection method of a generator, electronic equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a phase voltage signal of any phase output by a generator; determining a first magnetic flux parameter of the generator from the phase voltage signal; if the deviation between the first magnetic flux parameter and the preset magnetic flux parameter is smaller than the preset deviation range, outputting a power supply enabling signal; wherein a power enable signal is used to indicate that the generator matches the electronic device. By the mode, when the deviation between the first magnetic flux parameter and the preset magnetic flux parameter is smaller than the preset deviation range, the main power loop can convert the voltage output from the generator to the electronic equipment, so that the situation that the generator is not matched with the electronic equipment can be avoided, and the safety of the generator and the electronic equipment can be improved.

title: SVG intelligent early warning and fault refinement processing system
abstract: The utility model discloses an SVG intelligent early warning and fault refined processing system, which comprises a main power supply system, wherein the main power supply system is electrically connected with an intelligent early warning system, the intelligent early warning system comprises a monitoring module, the monitoring module is electrically connected with a transmission module, the transmission module is electrically connected with a signal coding module and a collecting system, the signal coding module is electrically connected with a digital display module, the transmission module is connected with a central control system, and the central control system comprises an adjusting module; according to the intelligent early warning system, the design of the intelligent early warning system is added, the signal coding module converts real-time working conditions of all components into signals through the transmission module and feeds the signals back to the monitoring module when the monitoring module monitors that the signals are abnormal, and the signals are fed back to the adjusting module, so that the adjusting module starts to adjust and lock, various power utilization components are protected and early warned in time, the damage probability of a power supply system is reduced, and the practicability of the intelligent early warning system is improved.

title: Three-level inverter modulation method, electronic device, and computer-readable storage medium
abstract: The invention discloses a three-level inverter modulation method, electronic equipment and a computer readable storage medium, wherein the three-level inverter comprises a positive bus capacitor and a negative bus capacitor, and the method comprises the following steps: collecting first voltages at two ends of a positive bus capacitor and second voltages at two ends of a negative bus capacitor, and calculating a voltage difference value between the first voltages and the second voltages; determining a zero sequence modulation algorithm to be executed according to the magnitude relation between the voltage difference value and a preset differential pressure threshold value; and modulating the three-phase initial modulation wave according to a zero sequence modulation algorithm to obtain a three-phase intermediate modulation wave. Compared with the related art, the invention can better adapt to the requirements of the application scene of neutral point potential balance when carrying out the voltage balance of the positive bus and the negative bus, improves the voltage utilization rate, reduces the inverter loss and further improves the safe operation coefficient of the inverter.

title: Power module protection circuit and electric equipment
abstract: The utility model relates to a power module protection circuit and consumer, this power module protection circuit is used for comparing the reference voltage that first power output and the voltage signal that power module output through multiplexing port through voltage comparison circuit to under the condition that reference voltage is greater than voltage signal, output fault signal to the controller, can make the power module use multiplexing port to output fault signal and temperature signal's condition, the controller can sample the temperature information of power module at high temperature range, and because voltage comparison circuit just outputs fault signal under the condition that reference voltage is greater than voltage signal, also can avoid appearing the error triggering power module's protect function.

title: Air conditioner, control method and device thereof and readable storage medium
abstract: The invention discloses an air conditioner control method, which comprises the following steps: acquiring the current total current of the electricity environment where the air conditioner is located and acquiring the target frequency of the last frequency reduction operation of the air conditioner; when the total current is in a preset interval, determining the current target frequency of the air conditioner according to the total current and the target frequency of the last frequency reduction operation; and reducing the operating frequency of the air conditioner according to the determined target frequency. The invention also discloses an air conditioner control device, an air conditioner and a readable storage medium. The invention is closer to the operating characteristic of the circuit on-off device, improves the effective utilization degree of the electric quantity in the power utilization environment, and more reliably prevents the circuit on-off device from tripping.

title: Nickel-based metal phosphate catalyst and preparation method and application thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a supported nickel-based metal phosphate catalyst and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the supported nickel-based metal phosphate catalyst comprises a catalytic center and a carrier, the catalytic center is non-noble metal nickel, and the carrier is a series of metal phosphates containing different metals; the nickel metal particles are uniformly distributed on the surface of the carrier and in the pore structure and are tightly combined with the carrier to form the catalyst. The catalyst takes metal phosphate with a porous structure formed by the reaction of different types of metal chloride and ammonium dihydrogen phosphate as a carrier, and the purpose of regulating and controlling Lewis acid sites and Bronsted acid sites of the carrier is achieved by regulating and controlling the types of metals in the metal phosphate carrier, so that the nickel-based metal phosphate catalyst with the optimal catalytic activity is obtained. Ni is uniformly loaded on the surface of the carrier and in the hollow structure by an impregnation method, and the strong metal-carrier interaction can effectively prevent the falling and sintering of active metal. The optimized carrier acidity can promote the hydrodeoxygenation of vanillin together with the active metal nickel to the maximum extent.

title: Plasma catalyst and preparation method and application thereof
abstract: The invention relates to the field of plasma catalysts, and discloses a plasma catalyst, a preparation method and application thereof. The catalyst comprises a carrier, an active component element and an auxiliary element which are supported on the carrier, wherein the carrier is selected from Al 2 O 3 、SiO 2 、MgO、ZrO 2 At least one of molecular sieves, wherein the active component element is selected from at least one of Pt, rh, pd, ir, and the auxiliary element is selected from non-noble metals of group VIIIAt least one of an element and a group IB metal element. The catalyst provided by the invention can adapt to the composition change of tail gas after the natural gas is subjected to plasma reaction, realizes the one-step conversion of the natural gas into acrylic acid under low temperature and normal pressure, and can effectively and stably improve the selectivity of the acrylic acid.

title: Nitrogen-doped carbon-supported copper/cerium dioxide composite catalyst and preparation method and application thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a nitrogen-doped carbon-loaded metal copper/cerium oxide composite catalyst, which is characterized in that nitrogen-doped carbon-coated cerium oxide is taken as a carrier, and metal copper particles are uniformly distributed on the surface of the carrier step by step; wherein the loading amount of the metal copper is 5-10 wt%, and the content of cerium oxide in the carrier is 10-20 wt%. The invention combines the carbothermic method and the dipping method, can obtain the composite catalyst which simultaneously has a metal copper active site and a nitrogen-doped carbon active site, and the formed biorthogonal active site composite catalyst has high selectivity, realizes higher reaction conversion rate on the basis of relatively mild reaction conditions and has good application effect; and the related preparation method is simple, convenient to operate and suitable for popularization and use.

title: VS (virtual switch)2Layered silicate nano composite catalyst and preparation and application thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a VS 2 /layered silicate nano composite catalyst, and preparation and application thereof. The VS 2 /layered silicate nano composite catalyst composition comprises a VS 2 two-dimensional nano sheet and a single layered silicate disc, wherein the layered silicate disc is in island composite distribution on a VS 2 nano sheet in structure, and the distance between the farthest side of the VS 2 nano sheet is far greater than the diameter of the silicate disc. The VS 2 /layered silicate nano composite catalyst obtained by the invention can be used for the reaction of preparing cyclohexene by partial hydrogenation of benzene. The invention solves the problems of low hydrophilicity and activity of the benzene water phase partial hydrogenation catalyst, realizes high hydrophilicity and high activity exposure of the catalyst in the reaction, and finally obtains high cyclohexene yield.

title: Ozone decomposition catalyst and preparation method and application thereof
abstract: The invention provides an ozone decomposition catalyst and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps: (1) mixing insoluble manganese salt and soluble zirconium salt with a solvent, stirring, and drying to obtain a mixed material; (2) the ozone decomposition catalyst is obtained after roasting treatment is carried out on the mixed material obtained in the step (1), and a small amount of zirconium is doped in the manganese oxide, so that the stability and the catalytic performance of the catalyst can be obviously improved, and the water resistance of the catalyst is improved.

title: Negative pole piece and preparation method and application thereof
abstract: The application relates to a negative pole piece, a preparation method and application thereof. The negative electrode plate comprises a current collector, and a first active layer, a conductive layer and a second active layer which are sequentially laminated on the surface of the current collector; the material of the first active layer includes a first active material including a carbon material; the material of the conductive layer comprises a conductive agent; the material of the second active layer includes a second active material including a sheet-like silicon-based material. The negative electrode plate can enable the battery to have higher specific capacity and cycle stability.

title: Lithium ion battery cathode material synthesized by low-temperature heating of polyhydric alcohol and application thereof
abstract: The invention relates to a lithium ion battery cathode material synthesized by heating polyhydric alcohol at low temperature. The material is prepared by the following method, comprising the following steps: dissolving antimony trichloride in triethylene glycol to obtain a mixed solution A; adding selenium powder into a mixed solution of monoethanolamine and thioglycollic acid to obtain a selenium precursor solution; then mixing the selenium precursor solution, polyvinylpyrrolidone and triethylene glycol to obtain a mixed solution B; and finally, pouring the mixed solution A into a container containing the mixed solution B, stirring, placing the mixed solution A into a condenser, heating to 175-185 ℃ in a nitrogen atmosphere, reacting for 15-25 min, cooling to room temperature, and washing to obtain antimony selenide nanorods, namely the lithium ion battery cathode material.

title: Positive electrode material, preparation method, pole piece and battery
abstract: The invention relates to a positive electrode material, a preparation method, a pole piece and a battery. The positive electrode material comprises a covered wire structure, wherein the covered wire structure comprises a core material and a shell layer which axially covers the core material, the core material comprises a sodium vanadium phosphate material, and the shell layer comprises a sodium ferric pyrophosphate phosphate material. The preparation method of the positive electrode material comprises the following steps of S1, carrying out coaxial electrostatic spinning on a sodium vanadium phosphate spinning solution and a sodium ferric phosphate spinning solution, wherein the sodium vanadium phosphate spinning solution is positioned at an inner layer, the sodium ferric phosphate spinning solution is positioned at an outer layer, and a precursor film is obtained, and S2, carrying out heat treatment on the precursor film under a protective atmosphere. According to the invention, the sodium ferric phosphate material is coated with the sodium vanadium phosphate material to prepare the one-dimensional nano-covered wire structure, and the one-dimensional nano-covered wire structure is used as a positive electrode material in a battery, so that the rate capability and the cycle performance of the battery are improved.

title: Lithium ion battery positive electrode material, preparation method thereof and lithium ion battery
abstract: The invention provides a lithium ion battery anode material, a preparation method thereof and a lithium ion battery. The positive electrode material comprises an inner core layer and a surface coating layer, wherein the surface coating layer is coated on the surface of the inner core layer, the inner core layer is used for providing lithium ions for the charge and discharge process of the lithium ion battery, and the surface coating layer is made of ion conducting materials coated by electronic conducting materials. The lithium ion battery anode material provided by the invention has higher specific discharge capacity and cycle stability. Meanwhile, the preparation method provided by the invention has the advantages of simple process, low cost and easiness in expanding production, and industrialization is realized.

title: Electrode assembly and battery
abstract: The utility model provides an electrode assembly and a battery. The first aspect of the utility model provides an electrode assembly, comprising a positive electrode plate and a negative electrode plate, wherein the surface of a positive electrode current collector is provided with elastic coatings positioned at two sides of a positive electrode active material layer, and the elastic coatings are arranged at two sides of the positive electrode active material layer, so that the distance between the negative electrode active material layer and the positive electrode active material layer can be increased, and a certain expansion space is reserved for the negative electrode plate, thereby reducing the risk of lithium precipitation of the electrode plate and fracture at a fillet, and improving the cycle performance and safety of a battery; meanwhile, the elastic coating provided by the utility model is suitable for the positive electrode plate with high surface density and high compaction density, and does not influence the use and preparation of the positive electrode active material layer.

title: Medical instrument assembly and method of connecting medical instrument assembly
abstract: The application discloses a medical instrument assembly, which comprises a body, wherein the body comprises a first surface and at least one first connector arranged on the first surface, the first connector comprises a first top part, a first bottom part and a first side part connected with the first top part and the first bottom part, the first top part is positioned on the first surface, the first bottom part and the first top part are arranged at intervals along the thickness direction of the body, and the section size of the first connector in the thickness direction is gradually increased along the direction away from the first surface. The application also discloses a connecting method of the medical instrument assembly, which is used for connecting the medical instrument assembly and the target part, wherein one of the medical instrument assembly and the target part is made of metal, and the other is made of high polymer material or plastic. According to the medical instrument assembly disclosed by the application, the first side part is provided with the accommodating groove which is recessed towards the inside of the first joint, and the adhesive is not easy to separate from the body due to the accommodating groove, so that the connection strength of the medical instrument assembly is improved.

title: Cupping device with medicine external application function
abstract: The utility model discloses a cupping device with medicine external application function, which comprises a cup body, wherein the top of the cup body is provided with an air exhaust handle, a liquid medicine storage pipe is arranged in the air exhaust handle, the middle part of the liquid medicine storage pipe is provided with a mounting plate, and a sealing plug is arranged below the mounting plate; the sealing plug is matched with a boss inside the air exhaust handle; a cover body is arranged at the end part of the air exhaust handle, and a spring is arranged between the mounting plate and the cover body; a slidable piston is arranged in the liquid medicine storage tube; a push rod is arranged at the end part of the piston; the cover body is provided with air exhaust holes in a circular array, and the middle part of the cover body is provided with a fixing through hole for fixing a liquid medicine storage pipe; the inside boss and the last boss of being provided with down of liquid medicine stand pipe, the utility model aims at providing a suction cup with medicine external application function combines the medicine to apply with the cup, and the absorption that has promoted the drug effect is opened in the pore when cup.

title: Photon skin tendering instrument with dustproof function
abstract: The utility model discloses a photon skin tendering instrument with a dustproof function, and particularly relates to the technical field of photon skin tendering instruments. According to the utility model, the alarm mechanism is arranged, the two lantern rings are sleeved at the outer end of the power line, the power line between the two lantern rings is in a bent state, once the power line is straightened, if the power line is continuously pulled, one lantern ring pulls the pull rod, so that one end of the pull rod drives the sliding block, once the spring is stretched, the two electrode plates are close to each other, when the pulling force is further increased, the two electrode plates are contacted, the alarm gives an alarm, the phenomenon that the power plug falls off due to the further pulling of the power line is avoided, and the sudden power failure of the device in the using process is further avoided.

title: Pulse detection device for clinical care
abstract: The utility model discloses a pulse detection device for clinical care, including middle part supporting seat, link mechanism, cam mechanism, the both ends symmetry articulates about the supporting seat of middle part has the holder, and the inside equipartition of middle part supporting seat is provided with cam mechanism, and cam mechanism rotates with link mechanism to be connected, and the finger standing groove has been seted up in the front of middle part supporting seat, and the ladder reaming has been seted up to the wall of finger standing groove left and right sides, and the installation storehouse has been seted up on the top of middle part supporting seat. The utility model discloses an add in the middle of traditional pulse detector and be equipped with the middle part supporting seat, set up installation link mechanism and cam mechanism in the middle part supporting seat, link mechanism gives the flexible massage piece of cam mechanism with power transmission, massages the finger of centre gripping, has solved the disease and has used pulse detector centre gripping finger for a long time and feel stiff, feels uncomfortable problem, provides more comfortable recovered environment for the disease.

title: Self-service registration device
abstract: The utility model provides a self-service registration device, includes a plurality of self-service registration mechanisms, self-service registration mechanism is including the organism that goes up and down to set up and be used for the drive assembly that the organism goes up and down, the fixed high control mechanism that is provided with in side of organism, high control mechanism includes the casing, set up the logical groove of perpendicular extension on the casing, the rotation is provided with the conveyer belt in the casing, and the conveyer belt sets up perpendicularly, a plurality of operation panels of conveyer belt fixedly connected with and a laser instrument, the inside fixed optical sensor that is provided with a plurality of vertical distribution of casing, the light that the laser instrument sent shines one of them on the optical sensor. The utility model provides a self-service registration device can be adjusted the height of organism by the patient according to the health condition of self is nimble to make things convenient for patient's registration.

title: F-shaped rod punching clamp
abstract: The utility model relates to a F-shaped rod punching clamp, which comprises a base, wherein a transverse rod positioning module is connected on the base, and a vertical rod positioning chute is arranged on one side of the transverse rod positioning module on the base; the cross rod positioning module comprises a supporting vertical plate, the supporting vertical plate is connected with three supporting transverse plates arranged at intervals at one side of the vertical rod positioning sliding groove, and a cross rod placing cavity is formed between every two adjacent supporting transverse plates; the three supporting transverse plates are respectively provided with a drilling guide hole and a limiting slot which are correspondingly arranged, and an inserting plate is inserted in the limiting slot; a F shape pole anchor clamps that punch, adopt horizontal pole orientation module cooperation montant location spout, the hole site on two horizontal poles of clamping processing, easy operation improves machining efficiency.

title: Screw feeder blade forming device
abstract: The utility model discloses an auger blade forming device, which comprises a mounting plate, wherein the upper end surface of the mounting plate is fixedly provided with two supporting plates which are symmetrically arranged, the upper ends of the supporting plates are respectively and fixedly provided with a fixed block, the inside of the fixed block is provided with a limit component, one side of the limit components which are close to each other is provided with a connecting component, a limit slider is arranged between the limit component and the connecting component, the upper end of the mounting plate is fixedly provided with a driving component, and the power output end of the driving component is respectively and fixedly connected with the connecting component, simultaneously still improved the stability of screw feeder blade shaping body.

title: Sheet metal part machining and polishing device
abstract: The utility model discloses a sheet metal part machining polishing device which comprises a polishing main body, wherein supporting plates are fixedly connected to two sides of the top of the polishing main body, an adjusting frame is fixedly connected to the top of each supporting plate, an adjusting groove is formed in the top of each adjusting frame, a movable frame is movably connected to the top of each adjusting frame through each adjusting groove, a limiting rod is fixedly connected to the inner side of each movable frame, a movable nut seat is movably connected to the outer side of each limiting rod, a lifting frame is movably connected to the front side of each movable nut seat, a first rotating motor is fixedly connected to the inner side of each lifting frame, a rotating support is fixedly connected to the driving end of each first rotating motor, and a second rotating motor is embedded into the back side of each rotating support.

title: Mounting base of cylinder sleeve processing die
abstract: The utility model discloses a mounting base of a cylinder sleeve processing die, which comprises a mounting base structure arranged at the bottom of the cylinder sleeve processing die, wherein rectangular clamping blocks are fixedly connected to two sides of the cylinder sleeve processing die, the mounting base structure comprises a support which is movably contacted with the bottom of the cylinder sleeve processing die, and a bottom plate is arranged below the support. According to the utility model, the double-shaft driving motor, the thread driving assembly, the L-shaped rod, the guide assembly and the clamping limiting touch assembly are arranged, so that clamping and clamping of the cylinder sleeve processing die are facilitated, automatic convenient positioning and fixing of the cylinder sleeve processing die without tools are realized by using a clamping and matching clamping mode, the fixing efficiency and the fixing automation degree are improved, the double-shaft driving motor is conveniently and automatically controlled to be closed and the prompting lamp is conveniently controlled to be opened when the clamping and clamping are in place by combining the arranged controller and the prompting lamp, the obvious prompting personnel are realized to be in a mounted and in-place state, and the convenience is brought to clear control of the personnel.

title: Hydraulic buffer device
abstract: The utility model provides a hydraulic buffer device has that buffer device height and buffering power size are adjustable, prevents the characteristics that fluid temperature risees, reaches the effect that effectively reduces the forging and pressing device vibration. A hydraulic buffer device comprises a buffer cylinder device and a cooling oil tank, wherein the buffer cylinder device is connected with the cooling oil tank through a pipeline; the buffer cylinder device comprises an adjusting screw rod, a plunger, a cylinder body and a return spring; the plunger is arranged in the cylinder body in a sliding mode, is connected with one end of the adjusting screw rod through threads, the other end of the adjusting screw rod is in contact with the forging and pressing equipment sliding block, and can move in the cylinder body under the action of external force; the overall height of the buffer device can be adjusted by adjusting the screwing-out height of the adjusting screw rod, so that the buffer device is suitable for the die assembly heights of different dies; the plunger piston is matched with the cylinder body to form a buffer cavity, and the buffer cavity is filled with buffer solution; a buffer unit is arranged in the buffer cavity between the plunger and the cylinder body.

title: PET composition and preparation method and application thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a PET composition and a preparation method thereof, wherein the PET composition comprises, by weight, 40-50 parts of PET, 5-12 parts of polyvinyl alcohol, 1-5 parts of epoxy resin, 0.3-10mol% of IPA monomer in the PET, and 79-96.5 mol% of alcoholysis degree of the polyvinyl alcohol. According to the invention, PET with specific IPA monomer content and polyvinyl alcohol with specific alcoholysis degree are selected, so that the adhesive strength and hydrolysis resistance can be remarkably improved.

title: POSS composite polyacrylate aqueous dispersion and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention designs and synthesizes a novel POSS composite polyacrylate aqueous dispersion. The dispersion is prepared under emulsion polymerization conditions with POSS having acrylic groups as a crosslinker. The aqueous polymer dispersion had a significantly greater molecular weight and average particle size than the control group without the addition of POSS. The coating prepared based on the POSS composite polyacrylate water dispersion has remarkably more excellent hardness and chemical resistance compared with a control group.

title: High-strength, light-weight and scratch-resistant polypropylene composite material and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a high-strength, light-weight and scratch-resistant polypropylene composite material and a preparation method thereof. The polypropylene composite material is composed of the following raw materials in percentage by weight: 45-90% of polypropylene; 0.1-5% of polymer type nucleating agent; 0-15% of nano inorganic filler; 5-20% of micron inorganic filler; 5-20% of a toughening agent; 0.5-3% of anti-scratch auxiliary agent; 0.1 to 2 percent of stabilizer; 0-5% of other additives. The polymer type nucleating agent has stronger induced crystallization capability than inorganic filler, so that the polypropylene has higher crystallization temperature and mechanical strength, and the dosage of the inorganic filler can be reduced and the material density can be reduced on the premise of ensuring the high strength of the material. The nanometer inorganic filler replaces part of the conventional micron inorganic filler, so that the total amount of the inorganic filler can be further reduced, and the size of the material is kept stable. The reduction of the inorganic filler can weaken white scratches of the material caused by the exposure of the inorganic filler after being scratched, and the introduction of the scratch-resistant auxiliary agent can further improve the scratch-resistant capability of the material, so that the material can keep better surface appearance after being molded.

title: Resin composition, composite adhesive film, copper-clad plate and preparation and application thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a resin composition, which comprises thermosetting polyphenyl ether and modified filler, wherein the thermosetting polyphenyl ether is obtained by carrying out redistribution reaction and hydroxyl-terminated acrylation modification on thermoplastic polyphenyl ether, and the modified filler is obtained by carrying out surface modification on inorganic powder by adopting a double bond-containing silane coupling agent. The invention also discloses a composite adhesive film comprising the resin composition, a polyphenyl ether-based copper-clad plate and application thereof. The invention greatly improves the compatibility between the interfaces of the composite materials, improves the uniformity of the filler in the matrix, and the obtained product has excellent dielectric property and flexibility and good peel strength.

title: Easily-cleaned scratch-resistant polypropylene material and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses an easy-to-clean scratch-resistant polypropylene material and a preparation method thereof, wherein the easy-to-clean scratch-resistant polypropylene material is prepared from the following raw materials, by weight, 100 parts of polypropylene resin, 1-5 parts of unsaturated carboxylic acid, 0.2-0.5 part of an initiator, 1-2 parts of a dispersion solvent, 0.1-0.3 part of an antioxidant 1#, 0.05-0.3 part of a catalyst, 0.3-1.2 parts of an antioxidant 2#, 0.5-2.5 parts of a lubricant and 0.8-1.0X parts of perfluoroalkyl alcohol, wherein X= (M 1 /M 1 ×M 2 )×N;m 1 is the added mass of the unsaturated carboxylic acid, M 1 is the molecular weight of the unsaturated carboxylic acid, M 2 is the molecular weight of perfluoroalkyl alcohol, and N is the carboxylic acid number of the unsaturated carboxylic acid.

title: Display panel, manufacturing method thereof and display device
abstract: The invention provides a display panel, a manufacturing method thereof and a display device, wherein ambient light can be collected through a hollow part of a light conducting layer, and after the ambient light is totally reflected at an interface between a second refraction layer and a first refraction layer and an interface between the second refraction layer and a third refraction layer, the ambient light is led out to a photosensitive element through a light leading-out opening. Therefore, the invention can achieve the purpose of flexibly setting the placement position of the photosensitive element only by optimizing the position of the light guide outlet of the light conduction layer.

title: Display panel and display device
abstract: The invention discloses a display panel and a display device, wherein the display panel comprises an optical component area and a conventional display area; the substrate comprises a plurality of pixels, each pixel comprises a light-emitting device and a pixel driving circuit which are electrically connected; the light emitting device includes a first light emitting device and a second light emitting device; the conventional display area is provided with a first light-emitting device; the optical component area is provided with a second light emitting device; the optical component region includes a first optical component region and a second optical component region; the first optical member region includes a first light-transmitting region and a plurality of first light-shielding regions; the first light-shielding region covers at least one second light-emitting device; the second optical component area comprises a second light-transmitting area and a plurality of second light-shielding areas; the second light-shielding region covers at least one second light-emitting device; the first light-shielding area and the second light-shielding area have no parallel edges. The technical scheme provided by the invention can enhance the imaging effect of the photosensitive element area of the display panel.

title: Optical film, backlight module and display device
abstract: An optical film, a backlight module and a display device are provided. The optical film is configured to receive and guide light. The optical film comprises a body and a plurality of optical structures. The body is provided with a light-emitting surface, an optical surface, a first side surface and a second side surface. The light-emitting surface is opposite to the optical surface, and the first side surface and the second side surface are respectively connected to two opposite side edges of the light-emitting surface and the optical surface. The optical structure is disposed on the first region of the optical surface. Each optical structure has a first surface and a second surface. The first surface and the optical surface form a first included angle. The first surface is a light receiving surface. The second surface is connected to the first surface. The second surface and the optical surface form a second included angle. The first included angle of the optical structure is gradually changed along a first direction from the first side surface to the second side surface.

title: Backlight module and display device
abstract: The utility model discloses a backlight module and display device, wherein, backlight module includes: a back plate; the mounting frame is arranged on the mounting frame at the periphery of the back plate, and a mounting groove with an opening facing the center of the back plate is formed; one end of the limiting piece is connected to the first side wall of the mounting groove, which is far away from the back plate, and the other end of the limiting piece extends towards the direction of the back plate; the edge of the optical diaphragm is provided with a through hole, at least one part of the optical diaphragm is inserted into the mounting groove, wherein at least one part of the optical diaphragm is inserted into the mounting groove, the optical diaphragm pushes the limiting piece to enable the limiting piece to be in an elastic deformation position, and the limiting piece automatically restores to an initial position to be clamped into the through hole. The utility model provides a backlight unit's optics diaphragm installation effectiveness is high.

title: Reflective display device and driving method
abstract: The invention discloses a reflective display device and a driving method, wherein the reflective display device comprises a bistable liquid crystal box, the bistable liquid crystal box comprises a color film substrate, an array substrate and a liquid crystal layer, the liquid crystal layer comprises bistable liquid crystal molecules and black dye molecules which are mixed with each other, all bistable liquid crystal molecules reflect invisible light rays in a reflective state, a reflective pixel electrode is arranged on the array substrate, a common electrode is arranged on the color film substrate, the bistable liquid crystal box is provided with a plurality of pixel units distributed in an array, the reflective pixel electrode is correspondingly arranged in each pixel unit, and the color film substrate is provided with a color resistance layer in a region corresponding to the pixel unit. The black dye molecules and the bistable liquid crystal molecules reflecting invisible light rays in the reflection state are mixed with each other and matched with the reflective pixel electrode and the color film substrate, so that the reflective display device can realize color reflection display with good display effect, and the reflective display device has the advantages of simple structure, small box thickness and low manufacturing cost.

title: Clamp rotating device
abstract: The utility model relates to a clamp rotating device, comprising: the device comprises a mounting seat and a braid, wherein a rotary mechanism is arranged on one side of the mounting seat; the rotating mechanism comprises a rotating cylinder and a rotating seat; the rotary cylinder is fixed on one side of the mounting seat through a bolt, an output shaft of the rotary cylinder is fixedly connected with the rotary seat through a bolt, and the rotary cylinder is used for driving the rotary seat to rotate; the beneficial effects of the utility model are as follows: the rotary cylinder can drive the rotary seat which is connected with the rotary cylinder to rotate, so that the first clamping plate mechanism and the second clamping plate mechanism which are fixed on the rotary seat can rotate along with the rotary seat to achieve the purpose of clamping paper carrier tapes, therefore, the device can clamp the paper carrier tapes which are piled together after one end of the device is produced in a reciprocating manner, and the device is inserted into the receiving rack at the other end of the device in a rotary manner, so that a finished product is separated and packaged, the working efficiency can be accelerated, and the labor cost can be effectively reduced.

title: Novel automatic paper packing device
abstract: The utility model provides a novel automatic paper packing device which comprises a base, an aluminum shell feeding module and a paper packing module, wherein the aluminum shell feeding module is arranged on the base; the aluminum shell feeding module comprises a motor fixed on the base, a rotary table connected to the output end of the motor, and a plurality of clamp assemblies fixed on the rotary table, wherein grooves are formed in the clamp assemblies. The novel automatic paper padding device can automatically punch the padding paper on the material belt and press the padding paper into the aluminum shell, and is simple to operate and high in processing efficiency.

title: General quick feeding and discharging pressing mechanism
abstract: The utility model provides a universal quick feeding and discharging pressing mechanism, which aims to solve the problems of inconvenient feeding and discharging of materials and unstable fixation of the tool. The pressing mechanism comprises a fixed block, the fixed block is connected with a compression spring, the upper end of the compression spring is connected with a pressing claw, the lower end of the pressing claw is provided with a pressing claw connecting pin, the pressing claw is clung to a pressing plate, the pressing plate is provided with a pressing plate connecting pin, the pressing plate connecting pin is connected with a height adjusting plate, the height adjusting plate is provided with a screw hole, and the screw penetrates through the screw hole to connect the tool main body with the height adjusting plate. Through a generalized design, can be used to the quick unloading of material of various frock compress tightly, flattening material, improve production efficiency, especially improve the reliability that water gauge photoelectric coding character wheel subassembly electrical property detected.

title: Paper mounting machine tilting mechanism
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of paper mounting machines and discloses a paper mounting machine turnover mechanism which comprises a main body frame, wherein a connecting shaft is rotatably arranged on the main body frame, a turnover plate is fixedly arranged at the end part of the connecting shaft, a driving motor is arranged on the side face of the main body frame, an output shaft of the driving motor is fixedly connected with the connecting shaft, an auxiliary assembly is arranged on the back face of the turnover plate, and the auxiliary assembly comprises an exhaust hole penetrating through the turnover plate and a mounting plate arranged on the back face of the turnover plate. This paper mounting machine tilting mechanism through setting up auxiliary assembly at the back of upset board to press the gasbag, produced air current accessible gas transmission cover and exhaust hole blow into between paper and the upset board, and then after the upset of upset board, can enlarge the clearance between paper and the upset board, reduce the adhesive force between paper and the upset board, ensure after the upset of upset board, the paper can be quick drop down, in order to ensure the availability factor of whole device.

title: Tapping alignment assembly for film sleeving machine
abstract: The utility model provides a flapping alignment assembly for a film sleeving machine, which comprises a connecting bracket, a driving assembly and a flapping assembly, wherein the driving assembly is fixed below the connecting bracket and comprises a push rod air cylinder, a first connecting base is fixed on an air cylinder rod of the push rod air cylinder, a second connecting base is connected below the connecting bracket in a sliding manner, the driving assembly further comprises a linkage mechanism used for driving the second connecting base to move, and the flapping assembly comprises a first flapping plate and a second flapping plate, the first flapping plate is fixed on the first connecting base, and the second flapping plate is fixed on the second connecting base. The beating and aligning assembly can realize that two beating plates move in opposite directions simultaneously, so that the foaming cotton plate in the film sleeving machine is aligned, and the next film laminating action is facilitated.

title: Wireless communication device, terminal equipment, signal processing method and system
abstract: The application discloses a wireless communication device, terminal equipment, a signal processing method and a system, wherein the wireless communication device comprises a signal selection module, a radio frequency module and a baseband module, wherein the signal selection module is connected with the radio frequency module; the signal selection module is connected with the baseband module; the signal selection module is used for selecting the first signal and the second signal and outputting the first signal and the second signal to the baseband module; the first signal is input to the signal selection module through the radio frequency module, and the second signal is not input to the signal selection module through the radio frequency module.

title: Communication device, control method, base station, and computer-readable storage medium
abstract: The invention provides communication equipment, a control method, a base station and a computer readable storage medium, wherein the communication equipment comprises a transmitting link, a receiving link, an antenna module, a coupling module, a correction frequency conversion module and a logic module, wherein the antenna module is respectively connected with the transmitting link and the receiving link, the coupling module is respectively connected with the transmitting link, the receiving link and the antenna module, the correction frequency conversion module is arranged on the transmitting link and/or the receiving link, when the correction frequency conversion module is arranged on the transmitting link, the correction frequency conversion module is controlled to work, the transmitting link can transmit a first correction signal of a second frequency point, the receiving link can receive the first correction signal and transmit the first correction signal to the logic module for correction of a radio frequency signal, and when the correction frequency conversion module is arranged on the receiving link, the transmitting link can transmit the second correction signal of the first frequency point, and the correction frequency conversion module is controlled to work so that the receiving link can receive the second correction signal and transmit the second correction signal to the logic module for correction of the radio frequency signal.

title: Electronic device, communication method, storage medium and computer program product
abstract: The present application relates to an electronic device and a method in a wireless communication system. An electronic device for a user equipment UE side, the UE comprising a plurality of antenna panels, the electronic device comprising: a processing circuit configured to: receive one or more downlink reference signals, DL RSs, from a base station via the plurality of antenna panels; and providing a beam report to the base station, the beam report indicating an association of the plurality of antenna panels with the one or more DL RSs, wherein the beam report comprises: a panel state of at least one of the plurality of antenna panels; an index of at least one of the one or more DL RSs received via the at least one antenna panel; and a channel quality measurement result for the at least one DL RS, is disclosed.

title: Method and device in first node and base station used for wireless communication
abstract: The present disclosure provides a method and a device in a first node and a base station for wireless communication. A first node transmits K1 first-type reference signal(s), and operates a first radio signal and a second radio signal; the K1 first-type reference signal(s) is(are) transmitted by K1 first-type antenna port set(s) respectively, a target antenna port set is a first-type antenna port set in the K1 first-type antenna port set(s); a first antenna port set and a second antenna port set are respectively used for transmitting the first radio signal and the second radio signal. The disclosure makes it practical for the first node to simultaneously operate radio signals transmitted from different transmitters in beamforming scenarios by connecting a first antenna port set and a second antenna port set with a target antenna port set, thereby improving the reception and transmission efficiency and the entire performance of the system.

title: Wireless communication method and apparatus, communication device, and storage medium
abstract: The present disclosure relates to the technical field of wireless communications. Disclosed are a wireless communication method and apparatus, a communication device, and a storage medium. The wireless communication method comprises: acquiring a long-term signal-to-noise ratio measurement value for performing signal-to-noise ratio measurement on a wireless communication signal; adaptively selecting a filter coefficient according to the long-term signal-to-noise ratio measurement value, and performing infinite impulse response low-pass filtering according to the selected filter coefficient to obtain a stable long-term estimation value; and performing signal compensation according to the long-term estimation value, and updating the long-term estimation value according to an actual compensation value.

title: Logistics transport vehicle collision avoidance device
abstract: The utility model provides an anti-collision device of a logistics transport vehicle, which comprises: the device comprises a vehicle fixing component, a damping component, a connecting component and a collision component; the outer side of the vehicle fixing component is provided with a damping component, the center of the outer side of the vehicle fixing component is provided with a connecting component, and the damping component and the outer end of the connecting component are provided with collision components; the anti-collision device for the logistics transport vehicle has the advantages of reasonable structural design, multi-layer buffering, better buffering effect, firm device body and the like, and therefore the problems and the defects of the conventional device are effectively solved.

title: Intelligent regulation and control system of vehicle bottom detection robot
abstract: The invention discloses an intelligent regulation and control system of a vehicle bottom detection robot, which relates to the technical field of vehicle bottom detection, and comprises a data acquisition module, a data analysis module and a path planning module, wherein the data acquisition module is configured to acquire all-round data information of a vehicle bottom of a target, the data information at least comprises position information of the vehicle bottom target, interval information among different vehicle bottom targets and profile information of the vehicle bottom target, the data analysis module is connected with the data acquisition module and is configured to execute deep analysis on acquired data and identify the type, position, shape and size characteristics of each target of the vehicle bottom, and the path planning module is combined with an optimized moving path generated by the distribution condition and parameter condition of the vehicle bottom target to be detected.

title: Intelligent vehicle is with positioner that has protective capacities
abstract: The utility model provides an intelligent vehicle is with positioner that has protective capacities, the cavity has been seted up to shells inner wall, cavity inner wall welded connection has the fixed slot, shells inner wall welded connection has strengthened the wall, shell outer wall bonding is connected with the rubber layer, through the casing, strengthen arm and rubber layer and solved the most not safeguard function of ordinary positioner among the prior art, in use easily receives the problem of damage, the problem of the complicated inconvenient installation of the most structure of ordinary positioner among the prior art has been solved through strong magnetic block, through the fixed slot, elasticity footstock and silica gel pad have solved ordinary positioner among the prior art and have mostly not protected inside, inside electronic components easily suffers vibrations and the problem of damage in the use.

title: Vehicle driving control method, device, system and storage medium
abstract: The application discloses a vehicle driving control method, a device, a system and a storage medium, wherein the vehicle driving control method comprises the steps of obtaining driving information and environment information of a vehicle, and determining whether to control a steering system of the vehicle to activate an output and input separation function or not at least based on the driving information and the environment information analysis when the vehicle collides with an obstacle so as to separate from a steering wheel of the vehicle and independently control the wheels to generate deflection of a target angle, wherein the target angle is an angle which can enable the obstacle to squeeze the wheels through rotating the wheels, drive the wheels to deflect transversely and further move towards a direction far away from the obstacle.

title: Vehicle identification access control system
abstract: The utility model discloses a vehicle identification access control system which comprises a transmission case, wherein a base is fixedly installed at the bottom of the transmission case, a vehicle intercepting mechanism is arranged inside the transmission case, the vehicle intercepting mechanism comprises a supporting block, a pushing rod and a transmission wheel driven by a driving assembly, a supporting column is fixedly connected to the surface of the transmission wheel, and a buffer assembly is arranged on the surface of the supporting block. This vehicle discernment access control system, through being provided with vehicle interception mechanism, utilize drive assembly to drive the drive wheel and rotate, slide in the sliding tray of square piece through the pillar, with this removal that has driven the catch bar, and make a plurality of first bull sticks and second bull stick rotate and produce outside extension, with this traditional barricade pivoted mode can be avoided, can enough avoid not judging the problem that highly produces and automobile body bump, and can improve the age of its use, avoid the rupture problem that weight caused.

title: Sewage treatment agent sowing device for sewage treatment
abstract: The utility model discloses a sewage treatment agent sowing device for sewage treatment, which comprises a box body, a stirring mechanism, a scraping mechanism and a spraying mechanism, wherein the stirring mechanism comprises a first motor, the upper end of the first motor is provided with a stirring rod, the scraping mechanism comprises a second motor, the output end of the second motor is provided with a threaded screw rod, the surface of the threaded screw rod is in threaded connection with a threaded block, the upper surface of the box body is fixedly connected with a sliding rod, the surface of the sliding rod is in sliding connection with a sliding block, a connecting rod is fixedly connected between the sliding block and the threaded block, and the lower end of the connecting rod is provided with a scraping plate. Through the structure, after the tank body storing the sewage treatment agent is emptied, the inner wall of the tank body which is remained with the effective sewage treatment agent is cleaned, so that the cleaning of the tank body is effectively maintained, inaccurate concentration of the sewage treatment agent and mixing of ingredients caused by the next use are avoided, and the sewage cannot be degraded effectively.

title: Sewage treatment device
abstract: The utility model discloses a sewage treatment device, which comprises a base, a controller and a box body, wherein a treatment box is placed on the upper surface of the base, a filter element is arranged in the treatment box, a water outlet is arranged on one side of the treatment box, a side plate is fixedly connected with one side of the base, the box body is fixedly arranged on one side of the side plate, and a first motor is fixedly arranged on one side of the box body; the utility model discloses a be provided with box and fixed case, in adding the box with sewage from the feed inlet through the water pump, open first motor through the controller, first motor drives the rotation of auger delivery structure, sewage filters in falling into the filter core from the filter screen, water after filtering is oozed from the filter core, and discharge through the outlet, and contain some bulky impurity and some flexible impurity in the sewage and discharge from the discharge gate, avoid causing the damage to sewage treatment device, the life of sewage treatment device has been improved, sewage treatment's effect has been improved.

title: Sewage treatment device with water quality detection components and multi-stage treatment
abstract: The utility model discloses a sewage treatment device with water quality detection components and multi-stage treatment, which comprises a water collecting tank and a first water conveying pipe, wherein a screening box is arranged above the water collecting tank, screening holes are formed in the screening box, a separation plate is arranged below the water collecting tank, a precipitation box is arranged below the separation plate, a supporting frame is arranged on the outer side of the precipitation box, and the first water conveying pipe is arranged on the right side of the supporting frame; according to the utility model, the screening box is matched with the sedimentation box, so that a user can filter out large stains in the sewage through the screening holes after pouring the sewage into the screening box, the sewage flows into the sedimentation box through the isolation plate, the lowest point of the first water pipe is higher than the bottom of the sedimentation box, the dirt in the sewage can be settled at the bottom of the sedimentation box, and meanwhile, the settled sewage flows into the water purifying mechanism through the first water pipe, so that the sewage can be conveniently filtered later.

title: Automatic cleaning device for cleaning inclined tube group in sedimentation tank and sedimentation tank
abstract: The utility model relates to an automatic cleaning device for rinsing oblique nest of tubes in sedimentation tank, include: a guide track disposed below the tube bank and extending at least from a first side of the tube bank to a second side opposite the first side; a purge conduit disposed perpendicular to the guide rail and configured for movement on the guide rail, the purge conduit having an orifice disposed thereon for gas flow therethrough; a blower connected to the purge conduit by a gas conduit such that a gas flow can be delivered from the blower to the purge conduit via the gas conduit, and a power mechanism coupled to the purge conduit and configured to drive the purge conduit along the guide track. The utility model discloses still relate to a sedimentation tank, it is provided with at least one such self-cleaning device.

title: Be applied to purifier of river drain
abstract: The utility model provides a purification device applied to a river sewage draining exit, which is arranged outside the river sewage draining exit; comprises a sedimentation tank, a water retaining wall, a reservoir, a water inlet pipe and a water drain pipe; the sedimentation tank one end meet with the river drain, the other end build the breakwater, the cistern setting behind the breakwater, the inlet tube pass the breakwater, both ends are realized that sedimentation tank and cistern are linked together, the drain pipe sets up in the cistern bottom. The utility model discloses in, can effectively reduce the solid particle in the drain discharge sewage and the impurity of dissolving in aquatic, prevent that river drain department from blockking up gradually.

title: Energy-saving equipment
abstract: The utility model provides energy-saving equipment, which comprises an energy-saving box, wherein two supporting plates are arranged at the bottom of the inner wall of the energy-saving box, ventilation grooves are formed in the two supporting plates, a water tank is arranged at the top of the two supporting plates, a water level sensor is arranged at the corner of the inner wall of the water tank, a ventilation hole is formed in the top of the water tank, and a transmission mechanism is communicated with the top of the energy-saving box in a sealing manner: when gas enters the energy-saving box, the gas firstly contacts the bottom of the water tank, the water tank is heated at high temperature, then the water tank is heated to be hot water, then the gas enters the top of the inner wall of the energy-saving box through the ventilation groove formed in the supporting plate, and enters the air delivery channel through the filter screen, and when the gas flows back from the air delivery channel, the power generation fan can be driven to rotate, then the power generated by the power generation fan is converted into electric power, the gas flows back to the boiler through the first connector for secondary use, and the utilization rate is improved.

title: Exhaust structure, compressor and air conditioner
abstract: The utility model provides an exhaust structure, a compressor and an air conditioner. The exhaust structure comprises a valve plate, a driving structure and a control structure, wherein the valve plate is movably arranged at an exhaust runner of the compressor. According to the exhaust structure, the compressor and the air conditioner, the exhaust pressure and the theoretical pressure of the compressor are detected through the control structure, and then the driving structure is controlled in an electric signal mode, so that the valve plate can be stably moved to realize the opening or closing of the exhaust runner, at the moment, the valve plate is not required to be directly driven to be opened by using the pressure difference in the prior art, the problem that fluctuation exists after the valve plate is opened by the pressure difference in the prior art is solved, the energy loss of exhaust is reduced, the noise generated by collision between the valve plate and the limiting block is avoided, meanwhile, the valve plate can be timely adjusted when the working condition is changed, the problem that the compressor is excessively compressed is avoided, and the working efficiency and the reliability of the compressor are improved.

title: Heat dissipation valve plate seat
abstract: The utility model discloses a radiating valve plate seat, which comprises a body; the body comprises a bottom plate and a barrel body integrally and upwards extending from the surface of the bottom plate, a water inlet hole and a water outlet hole are formed in the bottom plate, the barrel body is provided with a containing cavity with an upward opening and communicated with the water inlet hole and the water outlet hole, and a plurality of radiating fins are integrally and outwards extending from the outer side wall of the barrel body. Through the integrative barrel that upwards extends on the bottom plate surface to an organic whole outwards extends on the lateral wall of cooperation barrel and has a plurality of heat radiation fins, makes the heat that the valve plate seat produced in the course of the work in time discharge through integrated into one piece's heat radiation fins, avoids the valve plate seat inside to make the sealing member receive the damage or even become invalid because of the thermal-arrest, does not need often to change the sealing member, has not only effectively improved the life of air compressor machine, has still reduced the use cost of air compressor machine.

title: Air conditioner
abstract: The utility model provides an air conditioner, include: outdoor unit, indoor unit, throttling arrangement. Wherein throttling arrangement includes: an on-line pipe; the throttle pipe is arranged in the online pipe and comprises a first throttle pipe, a second throttle pipe and a third throttle pipe, and a plurality of through holes are formed in the pipe walls of the first throttle pipe and the third throttle pipe; the fixed end plate is sleeved in an interlayer between two ends of the throttling pipe and the on-line pipe and is used for fixing the position of the throttling pipe in the on-line pipe; the sealing slide block is sleeved on the sealing slide block in the interlayer between the on-line pipe and the throttling pipe and the springs at the two ends of the sealing slide block; when the air conditioner operates, the sealing sliding block moves from the side with high pressure to the side with low pressure, and the through hole of the first throttle pipe or the third throttle pipe close to the movable sliding block is blocked, so that the effective length of the throttle pipe is increased. The utility model provides an air conditioner can realize two-way regulation to can improve efficiency and compressor reliability according to evaporation, condensation pressure automatically regulated throttle length of difference.

title: Cooling device and air supply device
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a cooling device and air supply device, cooling device is used for the fan, including the casing, the casing connect in the structural wall of fan and follow the circumference setting of the air intake of fan, the inside of casing is formed with the cavity that is used for storing and/or circulate cooling medium for with the structural wall heat conduction of fan. Through the technical scheme, the cooling medium is stored and/or circulated in the cavity so as to be capable of heat-conducting and exchanging with the structural wall of the fan, and then the fan is radiated, in addition, the shell is arranged along the circumferential direction of the air inlet of the fan, so that the normal air inlet of the fan is not influenced, and the possibility of heating caused by the running resistance generated in the air inlet process of the fan is reduced.

title: Lipoic acid modified targeted integrin alpha v beta 3 nano-polypeptide carrier and preparation method and application thereof
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of medicines, in particular to a lipoic acid modified targeted integrin alpha v beta 3 nano-polypeptide carrier and a preparation method and application thereof. The nano-carrier provided by the invention is crosslinked by adopting a disulfide bond of lipoic acid, a formed polypeptide polymer can be rapidly degraded in cells and cannot be accumulated in the cells, arginine, aspartic acid, glycine and cysteine in the polypeptide are all in-vivo amino acids and have no toxic or side effect on cells and human bodies, and a CCK-8 method cell proliferation test shows that the prepared nano-carrier has very low cytotoxicity and simultaneously has better gene and chemotherapeutic drug co-loading capacity.

title: High-drug-loading-rate targeted drug loading system and construction method and application thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a high-drug-loading-rate targeted drug loading system and a construction method and application thereof. The targeting drug carrying system is completely composed of nucleic acid, and sequentially comprises a nucleic acid aptamer sequence, a connecting sequence, a single-stranded DNA molecule A, a single-stranded DNA molecule B, a variable structure sequence capable of forming a G-quadruplex, the single-stranded DNA molecule B and a reverse complementary sequence of the single-stranded DNA molecule A, wherein the size of the single-stranded DNA molecule A is at least 2bp, and the size of the single-stranded DNA molecule B is 2-8 bp. Compared with the targeting drug-carrying system in the prior art, the drug-carrying system has higher drug-carrying capacity and good biocompatibility, can be safely metabolized and degraded in a human body while avoiding the damage of an anticancer drug to normal cells, and provides a more accurate and safe targeting drug-carrying mode for the efficient treatment of tumors.

title: Preparation method of anti-human PDL1 nano antibody for blocking combination of PD1 and PDL1 and coding sequence thereof
abstract: The invention discloses an anti-human PDL1 nanobody and a VHH chain thereof, which comprises a framework region FR and a complementarity determining region CDR region, wherein the framework region is selected from amino acid sequences of FR1-FR4, and the CDR region is selected from CDR1-CDR3 amino acid sequences. Also disclosed are gene sequences encoding the nanobodies and host cells expressing the nanobodies. The PDL1 nano antibody has small molecular weight and strong specificity. The nano antibody can be used for soluble expression of proteins in escherichia coli, and has the advantages of simple preparation method, low cost and good application prospect in the aspect of detection of human PDL1 and in anti-tumor drugs.

title: Antibody-drug conjugate, and preparation method therefor and use thereof
abstract: Provided are an antibody-drug conjugate, and a preparation method therefor and use thereof. The antibody-drug conjugate has a structure as shown in formula Ab-[M-L-E-D] x , the drug is selected from a tubulin inhibitor, and the prepared antibody-drug conjugate has a better drug antibody coupling ratio and has a good targeted killing effect on solid tumors such as gastric cancer, breast cancer, lung cancer and urothelial carcinoma.

title: DNA methyltransferase 1 inhibitor and preparation method and application thereof
abstract: The invention provides a DNA methyltransferase 1 (DNMT 1) inhibitor which is a compound shown in a formula I or a salt, stereoisomer or solvate thereof. The DNMT1 inhibitor provided by the invention has excellent inhibition activity on DMNT1, has good antiproliferative activity on various tumor cells, can induce tumor cell cycle tissues and apoptosis, is stable in metabolism, and has good application prospects.

title: Candida sorbosa and application thereof
abstract: The invention provides candida sorbatidis, which is preserved in China general microbiological culture Collection center in 11 and 18 months in 2019 under the preservation name YN-1 with the preservation number of CGMCC No. 18954. The candida sorboso is used for preparing the amino acid water-soluble fertilizer by fermenting molasses alcohol concentrated solution, and the method for preparing the amino acid water-soluble fertilizer comprises the following steps: 1) taking out the cryopreserved candida sorbus protospecies, streaking and separating a single colony on a PDA culture medium, selecting the single colony to be inoculated in a liquid culture medium for activated culture, taking activated seed liquid to transfer to a new liquid culture medium, and performing expanded culture to obtain candida mycoderma liquid; 2) inoculating candida mycoderma liquid to molasses alcohol concentrated solution, firstly carrying out aeration culture, then standing and fermenting, and then carrying out enzymolysis reaction to obtain the amino acid water-soluble fertilizer. The candida sorboso can grow in the molasses alcohol concentrated solution with high brix, and can ferment the molasses alcohol concentrated solution to become an excellent fertilizer.

title: Method for extracting atractylodes macrocephala polysaccharide by using microbial fermentation method
abstract: The invention discloses a method for extracting atractylodes macrocephala polysaccharide by using a microbial fermentation method, which comprises the following steps: inoculating Rhizopus oryzae (Rhizopus oryzae) GDMCC No:60990 spore in Atractylodis rhizoma powder containing sterile water, fermenting at 28-30 deg.C for 2-3d, ultrasonic extracting the fermented product with water, and concentrating to obtain concentrate; precipitating the concentrate with ethanol and vacuum drying to obtain crude polysaccharide of Atractylodis rhizoma. The fermentation pretreatment of rhizopus oryzae CH5 is added in advance of the ultrasonic treatment of the atractylodes macrocephala polysaccharide. Rhizopus oryzae CH5 grows moderately in Atractylodis rhizoma powder to produce polysaccharide hydrolase, which can hydrolyze insoluble polysaccharide structure tissue of Atractylodes macrocephala, promote dissociation of soluble polysaccharide in binding state, and is more easily dissolved out during hot water ultrasonic extraction. Compared with the conventional method without fermentation pretreatment, the extraction yield of the atractylodes macrocephala polysaccharide can be improved by more than 50%.

title: Auricularia auricula polysaccharide and application thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a black fungus polysaccharide and application thereof; an Auricularia polysaccharide with average molecular weight of 1.5KDa comprises 8 monosaccharides.
