The preparation method comprises the steps of crushing the black fungus to 50-100 meshes, adding water, and stirring and extracting; 2) adding hydrolytic protease, oscillating at constant temperature, removing protein, and inactivating enzyme; 3) concentrating after enzyme deactivation, slowly adding ethanol with the concentration of 95% until the volume fraction of the ethanol reaches 75-85%, and precipitating with ethanol; 4) centrifuging, removing supernatant, and vacuum freeze drying the precipitate; 5) re-dissolving the precipitate to prepare a black fungus polysaccharide solution; purifying, carrying out chromatographic separation, collecting eluent, concentrating and drying to obtain the auricularia auricula polysaccharide; the invention screens out the auricularia auricula polysaccharide component which can improve the rehydration characteristic of dehydrated vegetables; the result shows that the auricularia auricula polysaccharide AAP-80-III can effectively improve the rehydration characteristic of dehydrated vegetables and better maintain the color, hardness and chewiness of samples after rehydration.

title: Mulberry enzyme and production process thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a mulberry enzyme and a production process thereof, wherein the formula comprises the following components: the production process of mulberry, white sugar and probiotics comprises the steps of selecting materials and preparing materials; step two, probiotic culture; step three, canning and fermenting; step four, filtering and purifying; step five, preparing mulberry enzyme; firstly, washing mulberry fruits serving as raw materials by using clear water, and then draining, removing stems and crushing for later use; activating the strain of the probiotics, and culturing for 48-72h to obtain a bacterial liquid of the probiotics for later use; the mulberry enzyme prepared by matching the mulberry, the white sugar and the probiotics has high nutritive value, and the raw materials have simple components and wide sources; through the use of probiotics, the mulberries are comprehensively fermented, so that the nutrients are micro-quantized and are more beneficial to the absorption of a human body; the production process used by the invention is simple and comprehensive, and is beneficial to popularization and use.

title: Composite enzymolysis synergistic method for lotus seeds
abstract: The invention discloses a lotus seed compound enzymolysis synergistic method, which adopts compound pretreatment liquid composed of sodium bicarbonate, sodium sulfite and trisodium citrate to realize lotus seed wall breaking and enzyme inhibitor pretreatment, prepares difunctional modified cyclodextrin through epoxy activation, amino functionalization and hydrophobic modification, targets an inclusion enzyme inhibitor through double functions of hydrogen bond and hydrophobic, uses a compound enzyme preparation composed of cellulase, pectase, neutral protease and alpha-amylase according to a specific proportion, cooperates with the difunctional modified cyclodextrin to realize synergistic high-efficiency enzymolysis, carries out high-temperature inactivation, filtration separation after enzymolysis, and compounds residues back into enzymolysis liquid after activation treatment, and finally obtains a finished product through ultraviolet sterilization. The invention solves the problems of low enzymolysis efficiency, easy inhibition of enzyme activity, waste of raw materials and poor product stability of the prior art, realizes the full-component utilization of lotus seeds, has complete nutrition and good stability of the product, and improves the enzymolysis efficiency and the product quality.

title: Electronic device
abstract: The application provides an electronic device, which comprises a bare chip, a bonding pad and a protective layer, wherein the bare chip comprises a device layer and a first insulating layer, and a first metal wiring structure is arranged in the first insulating layer; the bonding pad is arranged on one side, away from the device layer, of the first insulating layer, and orthographic projection of the bonding pad on the bare chip covers the first metal wiring structure; the protective layer is arranged on one side of the bonding pad, which is away from the bare chip, and is provided with an opening, and the opening exposes a first area of the bonding pad; the electronic device provided by the application has higher space utilization rate, the buffer layer can provide good support for the bonding pad, the probability of the occurrence of a crater effect of the electronic device is reduced, the wiring structure and the electronic element below the bonding pad are protected, and the yield and the working stability of the electronic device are improved.

title: Composite substrate, preparation method thereof and circuit board
abstract: The invention relates to a composite substrate, a preparation method thereof and a circuit board, wherein the composite substrate comprises a basal layer and a first resistance layer arranged on at least one surface of the basal layer; the thickness of the first resistance layer satisfies the following relation: d=1.2/R+K, wherein d is the thickness of the first resistance layer, R is the sheet resistance, and the value range of K is-0.3-3. According to the invention, the resistance R of the resistance layer and the thickness d of the resistance layer are controlled to meet a certain linear relation, so that the composite substrate meeting the equation has good resistance stability, and the preparation of the composite substrate by the method disclosed by the invention has the advantages of simple process flow, simplified preparation process and improved production efficiency of the composite substrate.

title: Circuit board and manufacturing method thereof
abstract: The utility model provides a circuit board, includes first substrate layer, inboard circuit layer, circuit substrate and a plurality of first conductor, inboard circuit layer set up in one side of first substrate layer, the substrate layer run through and be provided with first trompil, part inboard circuit layer in the bottom of first trompil exposes, first conductor is located in the first trompil, first conductor electric connection inboard circuit layer, every first conductor has the connection terminal surface of keeping away from inboard circuit layer, a plurality of the connection terminal surface expose in first substrate layer, every two the difference in height of connection terminal surface is no more than 3 microns, circuit substrate set up in on the connection terminal surface. The circuit board provided by the application can reduce the risk of empty soldering and improve the stability of the electrical connection between the first conductive body and the circuit substrate. In addition, the application also provides a manufacturing method of the circuit board.

title: Wiring substrate and manufacturing method therefor, and electronic device
abstract: The present disclosure provides a wiring substrate and a manufacturing method therefor, and an electronic device. The wiring substrate comprises a substrate and a plurality of pad groups located on the substrate, each pad group comprising at least two pads. Every two pads, among the at least two pads, which are adjacent in a first direction or a second direction are arranged at intervals, the first direction intersecting the second direction. Each pad comprises a plurality of edges; the plurality of edges comprise at least one selected edge and at least one non-selected edge; any pad is adjacent to another pad in the first direction or the second direction; the selected edge of any pad is the edge, among the plurality of edges, facing another adjacent pad; and the distance between the selected edge of any pad facing the another adjacent pad and the selected edge of the another adjacent pad facing the any pad is greater than or equal to 30 um and less than 100 um.

title: Electrical structure and method of manufacturing the same
abstract: A semiconductor device includes a substrate; a first insulation layer disposed over a first surface of the substrate; a second insulation layer disposed on the first insulation layer; and an electrical contact extending through the first and second insulation layers to electrically connect to the first surface of the substrate. The electrical contact includes a first portion disposed in the first insulation layer and a second portion disposed in the second insulation layer, the first portion has a first width, the second portion has a second width, and a ratio of a difference between the first width and the second width to the first width is less than 10%; at least one isolation feature extending into the substrate and disposed below the first surface of the substrate; and at least one conductive feature extending through the second insulation layer and the first insulation layer and into the substrate.

title: Image automation debugging method, system, medium and equipment
abstract: The invention provides an image automatic debugging method, a system, a medium and equipment, comprising the following steps: step 1: connecting the PC to the lamp box through the USB interface, and switching the color temperature of the lamp box according to the lamp box control command through an image debugging tool on the PC; step 2: after the color temperature of the lamp box is switched, the camera equipment is controlled to capture images by using the socket server through the Ethernet connection equipment, and the image data is transmitted to an image debugging tool; and step 3: calculating image brightness and color information according to the image data to obtain debugging parameters of automatic exposure and color; and 4, step 4: and sending the debugging parameters obtained by calculation to the camera equipment and the PC for image display. The method has simple steps, more automatic image debugging and no need of manually operating the lamp box and repeatedly iterating and configuring parameters.

title: Nano plugging agent, preparation method thereof and oil field drilling fluid containing nano plugging agent
abstract: The invention discloses a nano plugging agent, which comprises the following components: styrene, dimethylamine ethyl methacrylate, isooctyl glucoside, sodium dodecyl sulfate, potassium persulfate and deionized water; a preparation method of a nanometer plugging agent comprises the steps of sequentially adding raw materials to react, and directly cooling the obtained product; according to the invention, organic nano molecule polymerization is adopted, the preparation of the nano plugging agent is simple, the product obtained after the reaction of the raw materials is added is directly cooled, the final product has the effect of filling the pores of the mud cakes, a compact hydrophobic membrane structure is formed, and the plugging effect is obvious.

title: Folding angle detection method and device for folding screen and readable storage medium
abstract: The application discloses a folding angle detection method and device of a folding screen and a readable storage medium, and belongs to the technical field of terminals. The folding screen is an inner screen of the electronic device, the content display area of the folding screen is divided into a first display area and a second display area by a folding shaft, at least two Hall sensors are arranged in the first display area and/or the second display area, at least one magnetic field generating device is further installed in the electronic device and corresponds to the at least two Hall sensors, each magnetic field generating device in the at least one magnetic field generating device is not in the same display area with the corresponding Hall sensor, and accordingly in response to folding operation of the folding screen, the electronic device can determine folding angles between the first display area and the second display area through the magnetic field intensity sensed by each Hall sensor, and accuracy of folding angle detection is improved.

title: Electrophoresis tank device for electrophoresis coating of automobile parts
abstract: The utility model discloses an electrophoresis tank device for electrophoretic coating of automobile parts, which comprises an electrophoresis tank main body, wherein a working tank is arranged on the left side in the electrophoresis tank main body, a separation block is arranged on the right side of the working tank, a motor is fixedly connected to the bottom in the separation block, a first gear is fixedly connected to the middle of the bottom end of the motor, a second gear is meshed and connected to the right side of the first gear, the second gear is fixedly connected to the middle lower part of the periphery of a first rotating shaft, and a second stirring blade is fixedly connected to the top end of the first rotating shaft through a separation plate. According to the electrophoresis device, the first gear can be driven by the motor through the combination of the two gears, so that the first rotating shaft and the second rotating shaft are driven to rotate through the second gear and the third gear, the first stirring blade and the second stirring blade rotate, the electrophoresis liquid in the device cannot be condensed, the industrial production is facilitated, the production efficiency is improved through phase change, and the electrophoresis device is worthy of great popularization.

title: SYSTEM FOR MEASURING AND MONITORING THE RESISTANT TORQUE IN THE ROTARY JOINTS OF PARABOLIC CYLINDER COLLECTOR ASSEMBLIES AND MEASUREMENT PROCEDURE (Machine-translation by Google Translate, not legally binding)
abstract: A system for measuring and monitoring the resistive torque in the rotary joints of parabolic trough collector assemblies and a measurement procedure refers to a system consisting mainly of at least one collector assembly with at least one hydraulic cylinder for its rotary displacement and a portable device equipped with pressure sensors, connected to the cylinder chambers located on both sides of the piston, and at least one inclinometer for measuring the angle of the collector, and further equipped with components to, by means of an algorithm, perform the measurement of the resistive torque in the rotary joints used in the joining of solar collector assemblies to each other, as well as for the rotary joints located in the joint between the collector assemblies and different components of the solar field.
